question: What do the FAA guidance and drone manuals say should happen when a connection is lost, and what do the available incident reports add or leave uncertain?
stop_reason: claims still failing after the revision limit

intake.reason: summarize FAA guidance, drone manuals, and incident reports on behavior when signal loss occurs

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance states to try reestablishing the control link and, if unavailable, start emergency/contingency procedures for loss of control link and discontinue flight until inspection. Manufacturer manuals indicate RTH behavior varies by condition: Matrice 30T may display a pre-generated RTH path when lighting is good, or enter Original Route RTH when vision is unavailable, and the aircraft may remain in RTH even if RC signal returns; Matrice 4T automates Failsafe RTH on signal loss (triggered by user, low battery, or lost link) and can display an RTH path if vision/lighting permit, with special handling for long RTH distances; Autel EVO Max 4N describes reconnection attempts and automatic action if reconnection fails.

claims.text: When there is a loss of control link, the operator should 'Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft' and, if connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.
claims.quote: Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft

claims.text: If the connection cannot be reestablished, 'start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link'.
claims.quote: If connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link

claims.text: Discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft.
claims.quote: Discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft

claims.text: If lighting is sufficient and vision systems are working, DJI Pilot 2 will display the RTH path that was generated by the aircraft before the remote controller signal was lost.
claims.quote: DJI Pilot 2 will display the RTH path that was generated by the aircraft before the remote controller signal was lost

claims.text: If lighting is not sufficient and the vision systems are not available, the aircraft will enter Original Route RTH.
claims.quote: When the lighting is not sufficient and the vision systems are not available, the aircraft will enter Original Route RTH

claims.text: The aircraft will remain in RTH even if the remote controller signal is restored.
claims.quote: The aircraft will remain in RTH even if the remote controller signal is restored

claims.text: Make sure the RTH altitude is higher than any obstacle in the area.
claims.quote: Make sure the RTH altitude is higher than any obstacle in the area

claims.text: When the remote controller signal is lost, the aircraft will automatically initiate Failsafe RTH if the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH.
claims.quote: When the remote controller signal is lost, the aircraft will automatically initiate Failsafe RTH if the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH.
conditions: Signal Lost Action is set to RTH

claims.text: RTH can be triggered in three ways: the user actively triggers RTH, the aircraft has low battery, or the remote controller signal has been lost (Failsafe RTH is triggered).
claims.quote: RTH can be triggered in three ways: the user actively triggers RTH, the aircraft has low battery, or the remote controller signal has been lost (Failsafe RTH is triggered).
conditions: RTH can be triggered by user
remote controller signal lost (Failsafe RTH is triggered)

claims.text: If lighting and environment conditions are suitable for the vision system, DJI Pilot 2 will display the RTH path that was generated by the aircraft before the signal was lost.
claims.quote: When the lighting and environment conditions are suitable for the vision system, DJI Pilot 2 will display the RTH path that was generated by the aircraft before the signal was lost.
conditions: lighting and environment conditions are suitable for the vision system

claims.text: If the RTH distance is farther than 50 m, the aircraft adjusts its orientation and flies backward for 50 m on its original flight route before entering Preset RTH.
claims.quote: If the RTH distance (the horizontal distance between the aircraft and the Home Point) is farther than 50 m, the aircraft adjusts its orientation and flies backward for 50 m on its original flight route before entering Preset RTH.

claims.text: When the C2 link is lost, the drone enters a reconnection state and continuously attempts to re-establish connection with the ground control station.
claims.quote: continuously attempting to re- establish connection with the ground control station

claims.text: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.
claims.quote: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.
conditions: C2 link is lost; restoration within 10 seconds

claims.text: If reconnection is not established within 10 seconds, the Autel Enterprise App will display the warning and the drone will execute the preset Signal Loss Action or Signal Lost behavior accordingly.
claims.quote: the Autel Enterprise App will display the warning message “Aircraft disconnected.”, and the drone will execute the preset Signal Loss Action or Signal Lost behavior accordingly
conditions: C2 link lost; reconnection not established within 10 seconds

claims.text: During automatic RTH caused by signal loss, the drone will continue to attempt to reconnect (Condition: Signal Loss Action triggers RTH).
claims.quote: During the execution of automatic RTH caused by signal loss, the drone will continue to attempt to reconnect

claims.text: If the connection between the drone and the remote controller is restored during RTH triggered by signal loss, the drone will continue to complete the RTH process.
claims.quote: If the connection between the drone and the remote controller is restored during RTH triggered by signal loss, the drone will continue to complete the RTH process
conditions: RTH triggered by signal loss; connection restored during RTH

C001.rationale: The cited passage states: 'Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft. If connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.' This matches the claim conditions (loss of control link; if connection cannot be reestablished).

C002.rationale: The cited passage includes the exact directive: 'If connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.'

C003.rationale: The cited passage states: 'Discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft.' This aligns with the claim's conditions about control link inspection/testing before further flight.

C005.rationale: The cited passage says that with sufficient lighting and working vision systems, DJI Pilot 2 will display the RTH path generated before loss of RC signal.

C006.rationale: The cited passage states that if lighting is not sufficient and vision systems are not available, the aircraft will enter Original Route RTH.

C007.rationale: The cited passage indicates the aircraft will remain in RTH even if the RC signal is restored.

C008.rationale: The cited passage explicitly says to ensure the RTH altitude is higher than any obstacle in the area.

C009.rationale: The cited passage states that loss of RC signal triggers Failsafe RTH if the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH.

C010.rationale: The cited passage enumerates three RTH triggers: user action, low battery, or remote signal loss (Failsafe RTH).

C011.rationale: The cited passage states that if lighting/environment suit the vision system, DJI Pilot 2 displays the RTH path generated before signal loss.

C012.rationale: The cited passage states that if RTH distance > 50 m, the aircraft backs up 50 m along the original route before Preset RTH.

C013.rationale: The cited manual passage states that the drone enters a reconnection state when C2 link is lost and will continuously attempt to re-establish connection with the ground control station, which matches the claim text.

C014.rationale: The cited passage says that if the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller, aligning with the claim.

C015.rationale: The cited passage states that if reconnection is not established within 10 seconds, the Autel Enterprise App will display a warning and the drone will execute the preset Signal Loss Action or Signal Lost behavior accordingly, which matches the claim.

C016.rationale: The passage states that during automatic RTH caused by signal loss, the drone will continue to attempt to reconnect. It also references the preset Signal Loss Action/Signal Lost behavior being invoked when reconnection is not established, which aligns with the claim’s condition that a Signal Loss Action triggers RTH.

C017.rationale: The cited passage directly states that if the connection is restored during RTH triggered by signal loss, the drone will continue to complete the RTH process, matching the claim.

C020.rationale: The passage states ‘RTH then appeared to activate but the aircraft did not move any closer,’ matching the claim.

C021.rationale: The passage includes that Sport Mode emergency procedure was used and that it cancelled the RTH feature, after which pressing RTH again would not re-engage, matching the claim.
